name: safedoc-workspace
description: Dual-application ecosystem for intelligent document analysis and generation

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=chrome-extension && npm install --workspace=web-app && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=shared
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=web-app" "npm run dev --workspace=chrome-extension"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=web-app && npm run build --workspace=chrome-extension
